cancellation_summary: Any changes or cancellations must be made at least 3 days (72 hours) prior to your reservation start date for a full refund.
description: The ultimate small group sailing experience!
what_is_included: The Lagoon 380 is the perfect vessel for ultimate relaxation. With 4 cabins, interior tables & seating & the trampoline (netted) deck it’s a great option for a family gathering or friend group to spend the day on the water!
what_to_bring: Photo ID for all drivers and credit card used for payment required for check in.
disclaimers: Equivalent sailing experience required. A sailing resume will need to be completed at least 48 hours prior to rental for new customers.
